title: Phantom fault peak on the new pumps
scenario: The outer-race early warning fires on all four new gearbox-driven pumps at 702 Hz, every capture, three weeks after installation with new bearings. A firmware update changed the accelerometer gain the same week. The plant is close to switching the system off.
task: Explain where the 702 Hz line comes from, with the Nyquist numbers
Rule the firmware gain change in or out with a reason
Fix the 10 kHz to 2 kHz reduction without touching the signed-off detector
Say what to ask the sensor vendor and the sample rate needed to watch the mesh
acceptance: P07-P10 quiet, P01-P06 quiet, P03 still flagged near 772 Hz
1298 Hz attenuated at least 40 dB at 702 Hz; 100/300/772 Hz pass within 1 dB
2 kHz output and detector constants unchanged
ANSWER.md: aliasing explained with numbers; red herring ruled out

practices.label: Week 2 Mon - sampling, Nyquist and aliasing
Week 2 Wed - anti-alias filters and decimation
